description: Join Chintu and Mithu as they discover yummy shapes hidden inside their magical tiffin box. Fun, educational, and perfect for toddlers to learn shapes in English and Hindi! #Shorts #KidsRhymes #Cartoon
learning: Identifying shapes (Circle, Square, Triangle) through a fun, interactive food discovery.

scenes.text: Arrey! Chintu ke tiffin box mein kya chhupa hai?!
scenes.image_prompt: 3D render, close-up of a cute orange baby elephant Chintu looking surprised at a sparkling, glowing yellow lunch box, bright colorful background, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.text: Look! A yummy round roti, Circle shape, yummy yummy!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu holding a perfectly round roti, glowing golden light around the roti, cheerful 3D animation style, bright studio lighting.

scenes.text: Mithu, tap tap tap! Yahan kya hai?
scenes.image_prompt: A tiny green parrot Mithu with a red cap hopping on the lunch box, tapping the lid with his beak, curious expression.
A delicious square-shaped sandwich jumping out of the tiffin box, colorful confetti flying, 3D style.

scenes.text: Dekho, one, two, three! Triangle cheese!
scenes.image_prompt: A triangular piece of cheese floating in the air, Chintu and Mithu watching with wide sparkly eyes, vibrant 3D environment.
Chintu and Mithu doing a joyful dance together, shapes floating around them in the air like bubbles, happy atmosphere.

scenes.text: Hahaha! Tiffin ho gaya magic box!
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Chintu laughing heartily, holding his tummy, sparkles emerging from the half-open lunch box.

scenes.text: Ruko! Magic box mein phir se dekho...
scenes.image_prompt: The lunch box closing slowly, Mithu looking at the camera with a playful wink, blurred background.
